items.summary: Disposition: evidence_needed for fleet-wide security clearance; blocked for public exposure and security-sensitive releases; conditional for ordinary reversible growth. Risk severity: high for public exposure and security-sensitive releases, medium for bounded growth. Evidence: fleet-doctor has no run or control results; operations deploy-health, uptime, and error sweeps have no results; all 59 security sitefacts are unknown. Authentication and access boundaries, secrets handling, container isolation, release/deployment controls, dependency provenance, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, TLS completeness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness remain unverified. No incident or exploitation is evidenced; retained implementation failures are containment signals only. Compliance is a technical baseline with 37 pass, 16 fail, and 6 unknown. No certificate is reported expiring within 30 days, but complete TLS posture is not established. Exact decision: preserve private launch gates, block security-sensitive releases and public exposure, permit only bounded reversible growth that preserves existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, and data boundaries, and continue existing read-only evidence work. Do not retrieve credentials, change permissions or configuration, add dependencies, deploy, exploit targets, or conduct external outreach.

Retain the existing bounded read-only security evidence matrix covering authentication and access boundaries, secrets exposure, runtime isolation, release controls, dependency and supply-chain provenance, TLS, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and disclosure readiness. Record dated, redacted evidence and explicit unknowns using authorized metadata and retained artifacts only.
